title: ProxyX overview
description: Pool gateway, warmer and cache, session proxy, control API and ingester, limiter and edge proxy. Every query uses a metric documented in docs/metrics.

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: Scrape targets of every ProxyX role that Prometheus reaches.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Scrape targets that do not answer.

panels.title: Redis down
panels.description: 1 while a gateway or warmer cannot reach Redis.

panels.title: PostgreSQL down
panels.description: 1 while a gateway or warmer cannot reach PostgreSQL.

panels.title: Tunnels open
panels.description: Tunnels open per gateway. It falls to 0 during a drain.

panels.title: Connections by outcome
panels.description: One count per connection when it is answered.

panels.title: Refusals
panels.description: Connections answered with a refusal or closed at accept.

panels.title: Dial latency p95 by provider and stage
panels.description: A slow provider shows in handshake, a slow target in first_byte.

panels.title: Authentication failures
panels.description: unknown_key: wrong or revoked key. source_limited: a source held to the lookup limit.

panels.title: Lease limits broken
panels.description: Last-resort leases past a soft limit. max_conns and fair_use feed ProxyXLeaseLimitBroken.

panels.title: Control API requests by status class
Control API latency p95 by route
Ready units vs min_ready and low watermark
panels.description: Units that can be leased now (normal and degraded tiers), against the policy targets.

panels.title: Cache low (tier all)
panels.description: 1 when the leasable units stayed below the low watermark for low_for. This is the ProxyXCacheLow condition.

panels.title: Provider breaker state
panels.description: Worst state among the route classes of the provider: 0 closed, 1 half-open, 2 open.

panels.title: Sweeper reclaimed (15 min)
panels.description: Stuck state reclaimed after a crash or a lost message. 3 or more over a long time raises ProxyXSweeperRising.

panels.title: Static inventory by state
panels.description: Shared inventory. Replica copies are not extra IPs, so the panel takes the max across replicas.

panels.title: Rental days left
panels.description: Fewest days left among the provider's dated IPs. The alert fires under 14.

panels.title: Cost budget used
panels.description: Share of the cost budget used in the current window. The alert fires at 90%.

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Seconds since the policy and inventory snapshot was loaded. Reloads run every 30 s by default.

panels.title: Prober: age of the last posted result
panels.description: The canary interval is 1 hour; ProxyXProberSilent fires after 3 hours.

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Requests forwarded upstream. error means no usable response headers arrived.

panels.title: Upstream latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Time from forwarding a request until the upstream response headers arrive.

panels.title: Proxy overhead p99 by phase
panels.description: Time the proxy itself adds. lock_wait and ratelimit_wait are policy delays.

panels.title: Capture buffer depth
panels.description: Captures waiting to be published. The default channel capacity is 256.

panels.title: Captures published and dropped
panels.description: Any dropped capture is lost data.

panels.title: Upstream breaker state
panels.description: 0 closed, 1 open, 2 half_open. The value is the worst state among the tracked targets of that kind.

panels.title: Readiness and draining
panels.description: 1 is ready, respectively draining.

panels.title: Control API requests by status class
Control API latency p95 by route
Ingester flushes by table and outcome
Rows dropped and store retries
panels.description: Dropped rows are acked and lost. Retries only exist with the OpenSearch store.

panels.title: Ingester circuit
panels.description: 1 once consecutive flush failures opened the circuit.

panels.title: Capture commit lag p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Delay from a capture completing at the proxy to its committed row.

panels.title: Buckets against capacity
panels.description: At capacity the limiter rejects new buckets. ProxyXLimiterBucketsNearCapacity fires above 90%.

panels.title: Consume denied
panels.description: Denials are normal when orgs exceed their limit. A sudden share change is worth a look.

panels.title: Client connections, refusals and errors
panels.description: Open connections, connections closed at the cap, and connections that ended on an error.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: A restart resets every bucket.

panels.title: Egress connects by pool and outcome
Parents: usable and healthy
panels.description: parent_up is 1 while the parent can take requests (breaker closed and probes passing). parent_healthy is the active probe state alone.

panels.title: Egress addresses by state
panels.description: total, open (breaker), half_open, unhealthy (failed the active check) and prefixes.

panels.title: Parent breaker state
panels.description: 0 closed, 1 half open, 2 open.

panels.title: Breaker transitions and health checks
panels.description: Circuit breaker transitions and active probe results.

panels.title: Parent connection reuse
panels.description: Plain HTTP requests to an HTTP parent: reused keep-alive connection or a new one.

panels.title: Config reloads, DNS errors, access log drops
